text.p: Prime Capital Corp said Monday it completed the securitization of approximately $77.5 million of its equipment loan and lease receivables.
Prudential Securities acted as placement agent for this offering, it added. Fee and other income associated with this transaction will be recognized in the company's results for the first quarter.

"This securitization gets 1997 off to a strong start, and we are optimistic about the company's continued growth this year," James A. Friedman, chairman and chief executive officer, said in a statement.
Prime Capital provides capital and specialty finance services to health care and other industries.
